name: Omarchy Bar Pet
author: bol
description: Minimalist vector animated desktop pet with 4 animals (Cat, Capybara, Shiba, Bunny) roaming on an adaptive status bar runway with music headphones, typing, and care interactions

barWidget.description: Animated desktop pet roaming on an adaptive topbar runway, reacting to music, typing, system load, and clicks

schema.label: Pet Name
schema.description: Name shown in status tooltips and care drawer

schema.label: Animal Character
schema.description: Selected animal (cat: Cat, capy: Capybara with Yuzu, dog: Shiba Inu, bunny: Bunny)

schema.label: Runway Mode
schema.description: Runway layout behavior (auto: adaptive between center & right modules, fixed, compact: icon button)

schema.label: Fixed Runway Width (px)
schema.description: Runway track width when using fixed mode

schema.label: Max Adaptive Runway Width (px)
schema.description: Maximum width for the runway in auto adaptive mode (0 = dynamically fill gap to tray <)

schema.label: Typing Reactivity
schema.description: Animate mini laptop & paws tapping when you type on the keyboard

schema.label: Audio & Music Reactivity
schema.description: Wear glowing headphones and groove to the beat when music is playing

schema.label: Sound Effects
schema.description: Play subtle purr, snack, and click sounds on interaction

schema.label: Idle Sleep Timeout (seconds)
schema.description: Seconds of system inactivity before pet falls asleep

schema.label: CPU Stress Threshold (%)
schema.description: CPU load percentage above which pet sweats / stresses
